title: What they say when they feel unloved
hook: It stings. Read what's under it.
end_big: Tag who needs to hear this
end_sub: Hear the need, not the insult.
items: I can't see the effort. Show me, even small.
My needs keep coming last. Put them on the list.
I might as well be invisible.
Notice me. Ask about my day.
You never make time for me.
I miss us. Pick a night and book it.
I miss who we were. Let's find it again.
